title: Jalta Darwaza
body:
jalta darwaza gira aayi zahra ki sada
almadad ya fizza mera mohsin na raha
<<DIVIDER>>
zaalimon ne mere laal ko maar diya
almadad ya fizza mera mohsin na raha
<<DIVIDER>>
apni shehzadi ki imdad ko aao bibi
mere upar se ye darwaza hatao bibi
ay meri behen fizza imdad karo aa kar
darwaza giraya hai aada ne mere upar
almadad ya fizza almadad ya fizza
saansein rukti hai meri dam labon par hai mera
almadad ya fizza mera mohsin na raha
jalta darwaza gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
zakhmi haaton se ye darwaza sambhalun kaise
keel dar aayi hai seene mein nikalun kaise
ay meri behen fizza imdad karo aa kar
darwaza giraya hai aada ne mere upar
almadad ya fizza almadad ya fizza
koi tadbeer karo dard hai hadh se siwa
almadad ya fizza mera mohsin na raha
jalta darwaza gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
dard e pehlu mujhe uthne nahi deta behna
cha gaya hai meri aankhon mein andhera behna
ay meri behen fizza imdad karo aa kar
darwaza giraya hai aada ne mere upar
almadad ya fizza almadad ya fizza
phasliyon ke tukde de rahe hai eeza
almadad ya fizza mera mohsin na raha
jalta darwaza gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
tum ne har haal mein ki hai meri nusrat fizza
mere hasnain na dekhe ye qayamat fizza
ay meri behen fizza imdad karo aa kar
darwaza giraya hai aada ne mere upar
almadad ya fizza almadad ya fizza
dam nikal jayega mere shehzadon ka
almadad ya fizza mera mohsin na raha
jalta darwaza gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
badti jaati hai tapish aag ki aao jaldi
meri chadar mein lagi aag bujhao jaldi
ay meri behen fizza imdad karo aa kar
darwaza giraya hai aada ne mere upar
almadad ya fizza almadad ya fizza
dayr ho jaaye na bad raha hai shola
almadad ya fizza mera mohsin na raha
jalta darwaza gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
bul-hassan ka bhi abhi saath nibhana hai mujhe
apne waali ko layeeno se bachana hai mujhe
ay meri behen fizza imdad karo aa kar
darwaza giraya hai aada ne mere upar
almadad ya fizza almadad ya fizza
bibi jaldi de do mujhko laa kar ke asaa
almadad ya fizza mera mohsin na raha
jalta darwaza gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
mere dil se na juda hoga ye mohsin ka gham
hashr tak karti rahungi mai ye keh kar matam
ay meri behen fizza imdad karo aa kar
darwaza giraya hai aada ne mere upar
almadad ya fizza almadad ya fizza
mere bacche ne qadam dehr mein na rakha
almadad ya fizza mera mohsin na raha
jalta darwaza gira...
<<DIVIDER>>
royi be-saakhta sar peet ke fizza waiz
jab padha fatema zehra ne ye nauha waiz
ay meri behen fizza imdad karo aa kar
darwaza giraya hai aada ne mere upar
almadad ya fizza almadad ya fizza
meri aaghosh ka haq maut ne cheen liya
almadad ya fizza mera mohsin na raha
jalta darwaza gira...
author: Waiz Sultanpuri
